title: Austin's Budget: Small Business & Electric Focus
summary:
*   A special meeting was held to exclusively discuss the city's 1994-95 operating and capital budgets.
*   Presentations covered various budget components, including funding for city Support Services.
*   Discussions specifically addressed the budget for the Department of Small Business Resource.
*   Reports were also given focusing on the financial aspects of the city's electric services.
